title: Fix Bhoomi proposal copy and remove personalization, music, and photo UI

requirements.summary: Change initial proposal copy to fixed “Hey Bhoomi,” greeting and insert the provided Punjabi message before the Valentine question.
acceptanceCriteria: On the initial screen, the headline displays exactly “Hey Bhoomi,” (including the comma).
The provided message text appears between the greeting and the “Will you be my Valentine?” line.
The “Will you be my Valentine?” text remains present and has no trailing emoji.
There are no inputs or settings that change the name/message/affirmation used in the proposal text.

file_operations.description:
Update the initial proposal text block to use fixed copy only: set the greeting to exactly “Hey Bhoomi,” and insert the message text (with line breaks preserved):

ni tu ikk vaari keh de ke,
"mai teri aan"
dekhin,'taarun kiven mull tere pyar da

Ensure “Will you be my Valentine?” remains present and does not include any trailing emoji. Verify the component's usage instructions before implementing.

requirements.summary: Remove personalization UI/state so no user-editable name/message/affirmation is used on initial or success screens.
acceptanceCriteria: The personalization card/section is not rendered on the page.
No text inputs for name/message/affirmation are visible.
The proposal and success screens do not reference or display user-provided name/message/affirmation values.

file_operations.description: Remove personalization state (name/message/affirmation), remove the personalization card (Label/Input fields), and remove any derived display variables that read user input. Update the success screen copy to not reference any user-provided values (use fixed text only). Keep the existing single-page flow and current Yes/No interaction behavior. Verify the component's usage instructions before implementing.

requirements.summary: Remove background music functionality and controls so the app never initializes or uses the local audio hook.
acceptanceCriteria: No music controls (play/pause, mute, volume slider, or “Background Music” label) are rendered on any screen.
The app does not initialize or use the local audio hook for background music.

file_operations.description: Remove all background music UI (the MusicControls card and its placement) and remove the useLocalAudio import and initialization so no audio logic runs on initial or success screens. Verify the component's usage instructions before implementing.
Delete the unused local audio hook implementation to prevent accidental reintroduction of background music behavior.

requirements.summary: Remove the corner girlfriend photo so no personal image is displayed on initial or success screens.
acceptanceCriteria: No corner image/photo is rendered on any screen.
No broken-image placeholder appears in the corner areas where the image previously displayed.

file_operations.description: Remove the CornerImage component and any rendering of it in both initial and success screens to ensure no personal photo/corner image is displayed and no broken image placeholder appears. Verify the component's usage instructions before implementing.
